answer: Cluster identities by timing and answer similarity and treat each cluster as one voter. Every vertex in the graph joins a group when its pairwise correlation passes 0.8, and a group shares one reward anchor, so 50 fakes earn about what 1 does. Cost grows because decorrelating each fake means separate behaviour, hosts and funds. An honest pearl of unusual work stays alone. Weakness: patient attackers can add noise to evade clustering.
